text: 8月20日，上海市住房城乡建设管理委、市房屋管理局、市财政局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局、市公积金管理中心等六部门联合印发《关于优化本市房地产政策措施的通知》，自2026年8月21日起施行。《通知》规定，以需求为导向，结合“十五五”时期保障性租赁住房发展要求，各中心城区（含浦东外环内区域）推进二手住房收购工作，并加快改造出租，切实增加中心城区保障性租赁住房供应。
text_en: On Aug 20, six Shanghai agencies including the Municipal Commission of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Housing Administration Bureau, the Finance Bureau, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing Municipal Real Estate Policy Measures," effective Aug 21, 2026. The notice states that demand-oriented, in line with the "15th Five-Year Plan" period's development requirements for affordable rental housing, central urban districts (including areas inside the Outer Ring Road in Pudong) will advance the acquisition of second-hand homes and accelerate renovation for leasing to effectively increase the supply of affordable rental housing in central urban areas.
